system: Sri Lanka El Niño Alert System (SLEnS)

FIM.name: First Inter-Monsoon
FIM.el_nino_effect: Suppressed convection over 80-87% monitoring stations; early planting delay

SWM.name: Southwest Monsoon (Yala Season)
SWM.mechanism: Slow-Decaying warm Indian Ocean + WNP Anticyclone
SWM.el_nino_effect: Severe warm summer drought across inland agricultural zones, tank depletion, hydro power stress

SIM.name: Second Inter-Monsoon
SIM.mechanism: Convective thunderstorm activity & ITCZ equatorial waves
SIM.el_nino_effect: High rainfall reliability, cyclonic disturbance, pre-filling of major irrigation tanks

NEM.name: Northeast Monsoon (Maha Season)
NEM.el_nino_effect: Enhanced rainfall, flood risk in Eastern & Northern dry zones; climate whiplash

drought_severe.title: Severe Drought Mitigation Protocol
drought_severe.advice: Pivot from standard 105-day paddy cultivars to drought-tolerant short-duration crops (e.g. mung bean, black gram, sesame). Implement Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) water management on cascade tanks.

flood_warning.title: Maha Flood Whiplash Advisory
flood_warning.advice: Inspect spillways and bund sluices across minor cascade tanks. Prepare raised seedbeds and secure drainage channels to mitigate waterlogging.

normal.title: Standard Cultivation Protocol
normal.advice: Normal cultivation schedule approved. Continue monitoring weekly regional SPI indices and storage reservoir capacity.
